Data attributes
Product card · JavaScript · Buy · dataset.productId · "42" (string) · data-product-id="42" · Use as product ID
Read the diagram step by step

The custom attribute is attached to the Buy button. JavaScript reads data-product-id as
dataset.productId. The value is a string and visible to users, so never store secrets.
data-product-id එකෙ button එJකේම තිJයෙනවා. dataset.productId එJකෙන් string value එකෙ ගන්නවා. User ට Jම් data බලන්න පුළුවන් නිසා secret data දොන්න එපො.
